title: Onye Na-ekwu Okwu Ọlaedo n'Ọzara
intro: Chee echiche banyere nnukwu ebe obibi ọzara n'oge nchere na enweghị obi abụọ. Onye ndu ukwu apụọla maka nzukọ na Chineke, hapụ obodo nwere ọchịchọ maka ihe a na-ahụ anya iji jide. N'oge nkwụsịtụ ahụ na-enweghị nchekasị, onye na-eme ka mmadụ kwenye na-aga n'ihu na nkwa na-egbukepụ egbukepụ na ihe okike mara mma nke yiri ka ọ dị ndụ.
clues: Eso m n'ime ndị si Ijipt na Mozis pụọ, na-ahụ ka oké osimiri kewara maka mgbapụ anyị.
Anọ m na-ele mgbe onye ndu anyị gara n'ugwu ahụ ruo abalị iri anọ iji nata nduzi.
Achịkọtara m ihe ịchọ mma n'aka ndị mmadụ wee jiri aka m kpụọ ha.
Akpụụrụ m nwa ehi nke na-ada ụda, m wee kpọọ ndị mmadụ ka ha bịa.
Ewere m obere ájá n'okporo ụzọ onye ozi ahụ wee tụba ya n'ime ihe m mere.
Musa zutere m ma maa m ikpe ịsị 'emetụla m aka' ma bie ndụ dị iche iche, a ga-enwe nzukọ a ga-ekpe m ikpe.

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
